plan.warmup: one complete replay per binary, excluded; first 5-second reporting window excluded from steady-state summaries
plan.threshold: at least 10% lower median elapsed with no output change; raceability separately requires every steady 5s window >=29.5 graphics workloads/s (game_fps); dispatcher updates independently verified
plan.timings: render-cost CPU/workload/GPU windows; elapsed includes boot; no capture or sampler

limitations: game_fps counts completed graphics workloads, not dispatcher updates; replay verified_updates is independent.
First reporting window excluded from steady ranges; range endpoints are not per-frame percentiles.
Frame/workload wall times include GPU waits; overlapping times must not be added.
Boost clocks and background desktop activity not locked.
Rain animation follows wall time; fixed inputs are not a deterministic image/state oracle.
Practical settings change visibility and ray quality; their benefit is not attributable entirely to code.
No Android or Vulkan performance claim; no HD pack in this experiment.
